body: STALE SUMMARY CORRECTION REQUEST, source-verified at storymodel4s main e584ad6. The current sticky summary says arbitrary-text CLI intake is still blocked on Stage 1b. That conflates deterministic intake with semantic interpretation. core/atlas.scala already exposes StorySource.fromText for any nonblank decoded String; it derives distinct raw and canonical checksums and content-addressed identity. SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze then deterministically creates paragraph, sentence, and token units on the canonical UTF-16 axis and returns a checked SurfaceAtlas without any semantic provider. Stage 1b is required to establish propositions and a validated semantic StoryModel, not to accept text, preserve identities, segment its surface, or render an explicitly source-only result. The sound direct-input contract is therefore: preserve original bytes plus charset/BOM/decoding receipt outside StorySource; call StorySource.fromText on the decoded value; derive SurfaceAtlas; emit the versioned bundle with source identity/text and a visible Semantics not established outcome; emit no semantic marks, ViewBasis, omission claim, or borrowed fixture authority. An optional admitted model/provider may enrich the same invocation later. Please supersede the summary line and the CLI bead wording so the product queue no longer treats missing semantics as a reason to omit direct text input. This is a measured sequencing correction and contract review, not implementation or path authority.
